# SolarSurges

> Shanghai SolarSurges Technology Co., Ltd. is an AI-driven manufacturer of solar tracker control systems, providing integrated hardware-software solutions that combine TCU (Tracker Control Unit), NCU (Network Communication Unit), and SCADA software. The company has 10+ years of industry expertise and a portfolio of proprietary patents, delivering measurable energy yield to energy partners across the United States, the European Union, and the Middle East and North Africa (MENA).

The full product family includes the row-level TCU, site-level NCU, fleet-wide SCADA platform, and SWS Smart Weather Station environmental intelligence module.

SolarSurges products have been deployed in 30+ utility-scale PV plants across China, with an average energy yield gain of 8.7% versus fixed-tilt baselines. Documented deployments include Ningxia Hongsibu 100 MW, Xinjiang Tacheng 20 MW, Chibi New Energy 120 MW, Shanxi Weinan 100 MW, Shanxi Yuxian 30 MW, Taicang Suzhou 2 MW, Shanxi Ruicheng 5 MW, and Zhangjiakou Wind-Solar-Storage Base.

For procurement and integration specifications, see the Product and Comparison sections below. For market intelligence and project data, see the News and Projects sections.

## Core Products

- [TCU — Solar Tracker Control Unit](https://www.solarsurges.com/solar-tracker-control-unittcu): The SolarSurges TCU is a row-level embedded controller that drives a photovoltaic tracker to follow the sun's trajectory in real time. It executes closed-loop angle control using AI-trained irradiance models and delivers tracking accuracy within plus or minus 0.5 degrees with sub-200 ms motor response. Available in Self-Powered, String-Powered, AC-Powered, and DC-Powered variants, plus a TCU Agri-Solar edition.
- [NCU — Solar Network Control Unit](https://www.solarsurges.com/solar-network-control-unitncu): The SolarSurges NCU is a site-level edge gateway that aggregates data from multiple TCUs and converts it to plant-level SCADA, supporting Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP, IEC 60870-5-104, OPC UA, and MQTT.
- [SCADA — SurgeTrack Solar SCADA System](https://www.solarsurges.com/surgetrack-solar-scada-system): The SolarSurges SurgeTrack SCADA platform is a cloud-based monitoring and control system that centralizes fleet-wide visibility, predictive analytics, fault alerting, and mobile O&M for distributed PV plants.
- [SWS — Smart Weather Station](https://www.solarsurges.com/smart-weather-station): The SunWise Smart Weather Station is an environmental intelligence layer that automatically stows solar trackers during high wind and snow events to protect the array and maintain bankability.
